fusions.name: Percussion Shot
fusions.desc: Strikes a cap and fires a ball that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Muzzle Clap
fusions.desc: Strikes a charge that bursts through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Half-Cock to Full
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Report
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shot cracks out at the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
